notes: «قال حدثت محمدا، عن إبراهيم، بحديث عبد الرحمن بن بشر»: Ibn ʿAwn names Ibrahim as his source; Muhammad's reply («إياي حدثه عبد الرحمن بن بشر») names Abd al-Rahman as the one who narrated to him
The text does not settle which route the saying takes after Ibn ʿAwn; the chain is written only as far as the text names, and it needs a ruling (rule 9, rule 11)
«- يعني حديث العزل -» is a gloss on the subject, left out
